strings.AI 對話已關閉；桌面仍可照常操作: AI chat is off; the desktop works as usual
strings.AI 對話目前關閉。開啟後才會連接模型。: AI chat is off. The model is connected only after you turn it on.
strings.Ditto 想在這次對話中做一件需要你同意的事：: In this conversation Ditto wants to do something that needs your consent:
strings.G1 只接受內建來源的可信套件。安裝只放進套件庫，不會改變目前的組合。: G1 accepts only trusted built-in packages. Installing only adds a package to the store; the composition in use does not change.
strings.一般桌面沒有啟動，仍可在這裡修復。: The normal desktop did not start; you can keep repairing here.
strings.不能匯入，原因如下。: Cannot be imported, for these reasons.
strings.主螢幕是排列在最左上的螢幕。角色所在的螢幕拔除時，角色會移到主螢幕，接回後再回去: The primary screen is the one placed furthest to the top left. When the character's screen is unplugged, the character moves to the primary screen and goes back once the screen is plugged in again. When a window covers it, the recall shortcut brings it back.
strings.使用 Codex 訂閱登入: Sign in with your Codex subscription
strings.使用中的組合不能刪除: The composition in use cannot be deleted
strings.使用中的組合不能刪除；先切換到另一個組合。: The composition in use cannot be deleted; switch to another one first.
strings.使用你的 Codex 訂閱登入後即可對話。不會改用付費 API。: Sign in with your Codex subscription to chat. Ditto never switches to the paid API.
strings.兩者沒有差異。: There is no difference between the two.
strings.刪除「%1」？它的版本紀錄也會一起刪除。: Delete “%1”? Its version history is deleted with it.
strings.匯入內容不是有效的組合檔: The text to import is not a valid composition file
strings.匯出的內容不含檔案路徑與密鑰。匯入前會先檢查，檢查結果顯示在這裡，不會立即套用。: Exports contain no file paths and no secrets. An import is checked first; the result is shown here and nothing is applied yet.
strings.只允許這一次；下次需要時會再問。拒絕不會影響目前的桌面。: This allows it once; Ditto asks again next time. Refusing leaves your desktop as it is.
strings.只完成了一部分；請查看變更卡: Only partly done; see the change card
strings.只有部分生效，下列項目沒有還原。: Only part of it took effect; the items below were not restored.
strings.可以描述想調整的桌面: Describe what to change on the desktop
strings.可信的桌面元件在同一個桌面介面程序內執行，彼此沒有隔離；服務類插件共用一個插件服: Trusted desktop components run in the one desktop-interface process with no isolation between them; service plugins share one plugin-service host.
strings.和最近可用的組合相比，沒有新加入或變更的插件。: Compared with the last composition known to work, no plugin was added or changed.
strings.回到一般模式後套用: Applied once back in normal mode
strings.在桌面介面程序內執行（同宿主、無隔離），無法單獨計量: Runs in the desktop-interface process (same host, no isolation); cannot be measured on its own
strings.套件仍被某個組合使用，沒有移除: A composition still uses the package; it was not removed
strings.套用後沒有通過確認，已全部回復到原本的設定。: Applied, but the check afterwards failed; everything is back to the previous settings.
strings.完成；可以在變更紀錄撤銷: Done; you can undo it in the change history
strings.尚未取得宿主狀態: The host's state is not known yet
strings.尚未生效，之後套用: Not in effect yet; applied later
strings.已保存，還沒有生效：下次登入時才會套用。: Saved, not in effect yet: it is applied at the next login.
strings.已保存，還沒有生效：回到一般模式後才會套用。: Saved, not in effect yet: it is applied once back in normal mode.
strings.已停用。可以回到一般模式再重新啟用。: Disabled. It can be enabled again in normal mode.
strings.已匯入。匯入的組合不會自動套用，可以在清單中試看或使用。: Imported. An imported composition is not applied automatically; try it or use it from the list.
strings.已套用並確認生效。可以撤銷。: Applied and confirmed. You can undo it.
strings.已套用，正在試看。按「保留」才會留下；取消或逾時會自動回復。: Applied for a try. Press “Keep” to keep it; cancelling or waiting reverts it.
strings.已恢復最近可用的組合。: The last composition known to work is restored.
strings.已撤銷。撤銷本身也記錄成一筆變更。: Undone. The undo is recorded as a change of its own.
strings.已開始安裝。安裝完成後要另外啟用。: Installation started. Enable the plugin separately once it is installed.
strings.待辦服務暫不可用: The tasks service is unavailable right now
strings.待辦服務沒有回應，已知的待辦沒有被刪除。服務恢復後會自動重新顯示。: The tasks service is not answering. No task has been deleted; they come back when the service does.
strings.快捷鍵由 Ditto 綁定到視窗管理。同一組按鍵只能有一個用途；衝突會在套用前被: Ditto binds shortcuts in the window manager. A key combination can have one use only; a conflict is stopped and explained before anything is applied.
strings.恢復最近可用組合: Restore the last composition known to work
strings.應用程式清單暫不可用: The application list is unavailable right now
strings.指定的螢幕 %1 沒有連接，所以先放在主螢幕。: The chosen screen %1 is not connected, so it is on the primary screen for now.
strings.描述想調整的桌面，例如「開啟通知專注模式」: Describe what to change, for example “turn on notification focus mode”
strings.救援模式不執行插件服務，待辦會在一般模式恢復。: Rescue mode runs no plugin services; tasks come back in normal mode.
strings.方向鍵選擇，Enter 開啟，PageUp／PageDown 換類別，Esc 關: Arrow keys to choose, Enter to open, PageUp/PageDown to change category, Esc to close
strings.時間已到，正在等待自動回復: Time is up; waiting for the automatic revert
strings.查看目前開啟的視窗、工作區與螢幕: See the open windows, workspaces and screens
strings.桌面介面沒有回應，已被停止。你的應用程式仍在執行，未儲存的內容沒有被關閉。: The desktop interface stopped responding and was stopped. Your applications are still running; nothing unsaved was closed.
strings.桌面元件在組合中心選擇要放的位置後啟用。: A desktop component is enabled by choosing its place in the composition center.
strings.桌面服務一再失敗。你的應用程式仍在執行，未儲存的內容沒有被關閉。: The desktop service kept failing. Your applications are still running; nothing unsaved was closed.
strings.桌面服務以救援模式執行: The desktop service is running in rescue mode
strings.桌面服務未連線，需重新啟動工作階段: Desktop service not connected; the session needs to be restarted
strings.桌面沒有正常啟動。你的應用程式仍在執行，未儲存的內容沒有被關閉。: The desktop did not start normally. Your applications are still running; nothing unsaved was closed.
strings.桌面變更沒有完成；請查看變更卡: The desktop change did not complete; see the change card
strings.模型尚未連接；桌面仍可照常操作: No model connected yet; the desktop works as usual
strings.模型沒有回應；桌面沒有被改動，可以再試一次: The model did not answer; nothing on the desktop changed. You can try again
strings.正在套用並確認桌面變更: Applying and checking the desktop change
strings.正在理解需求；可停止: Working out what you asked; you can stop it
strings.每一次改變桌面都記在這裡，包含沒有套用成功的。撤銷會一步一步往回，較新的變更要先: Every change to the desktop is recorded here, including the ones that did not apply. Undo goes back one step at a time; newer changes have to be undone first.
strings.沒有停用成功，原本的組合沒有改變。: Not disabled; the composition is unchanged.
strings.沒有套用：新的元件沒有準備好，原本的設定沒有改變。: Not applied: the new component was not ready. The previous settings are unchanged.
strings.沒有套用：檢查時發現問題，原本的設定沒有改變。: Not applied: the check found problems. The previous settings are unchanged.
strings.沒有完成；可以再試一次: Not done; you can try again
strings.沒有恢復成功，目前的組合沒有改變。: Not restored; the composition in use is unchanged.
strings.無法確認密碼（系統驗證服務沒有回應），請再試一次: The password could not be checked (the system authentication service did not answer); please try again
strings.無法確認是否已生效。目前的實際狀態列在下方。: It cannot be confirmed whether this took effect. The actual current state is listed below.
strings.狀態：%1；過去 10 分鐘重啟 %2 次；%3: State: %1; restarted %2 time(s) in the last 10 minutes; %3
strings.目前沒有顯示角色。: The character is not shown right now.
strings.移動、調整大小、切換或要求關閉視窗: Move, resize, switch or ask to close windows
strings.系統已設定減少動畫，這裡關閉也不會恢復動畫。系統設定在桌面啟動時讀取。: The system asks for reduced motion, so turning it off here does not bring motion back. The system setting is read when the desktop starts.
strings.系統的減少動畫設定在桌面啟動時讀取，兩者任一開啟都會減少動畫。: The system's reduced-motion setting is read when the desktop starts; either one turned on reduces motion.
strings.結果尚未確認；不要重複送出，請查看變更紀錄: The result is not confirmed yet; do not send it again — see the change history
strings.與 %1 個插件共用宿主，無法單獨計量；%2: Shares its host with %1 plugin(s) and cannot be measured on its own; %2
strings.與目前使用的比較: Compare with the one in use
strings.訂閱額度已用完；等額度重設後再試: Subscription quota used up; try again after it resets
strings.設定已改回，但下列項目無法還原。: The settings are back, but the items below could not be restored.
strings.請在瀏覽器完成登入。完成後這裡會自動更新。: Finish signing in in your browser. This updates by itself when you are done.
strings.輸入密碼後按 Enter 解鎖: Type your password and press Enter to unlock
strings.這個動作沒有完成。可以查看診斷。: This action did not complete. See the diagnostics.
strings.這個服務連續失敗，已被自動停用，桌面其他部分不受影響。可以查看診斷後重新啟用。: This service failed repeatedly and was disabled automatically; the rest of the desktop is not affected. Check the diagnostics, then enable it again.
strings.這項變更已被回復，目前是變更前的設定。: This change was reverted; the settings are as they were before it.
strings.通知規則暫不可用，通知會全部顯示。: Notification rules are unavailable right now; all notifications are shown.
strings.連不上桌面服務。可以改用文字救援工具。: The desktop service cannot be reached. The text rescue tool still works.
strings.選兩個版本（起點、終點）比較差異。每個版本都標示它是怎麼來的。: Pick two versions (from, to) to compare them. Each version says where it came from.
strings.選擇一個元件後可以先「試看」（倒數後自動回復，按保留才留下）或直接「套用」。原本: After choosing a component you can “Try it” (it reverts after a countdown unless you keep it) or “Apply” it. The replaced component keeps its settings and gets them back when you switch back.
strings.還沒有最近可用的組合可以比較。: There is no composition known to work to compare with yet.
strings.釘選沒有變更: The pinned list did not change
strings.鍵盤焦點一律以外框標示，所有操作都可以只用 Tab、Enter、空白鍵與方向鍵完: Keyboard focus is always drawn as an outline, and everything can be done with Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys. Every button and field has a name a screen reader can read; states are also written as text, never shown by colour or motion alone.
strings.關閉「降低透明度」後會出現倒數，按「保留」才會留下，避免看不清楚時無法改回。: Turning “Reduce transparency” off starts a countdown; press “Keep” to keep it, so an unreadable screen reverts by itself.

keys.change.candidate_not_ready: The new component was not ready, so nothing was applied.
keys.change.commit_failed: Applying failed part-way; a revert was attempted.
keys.change.commit_write_failed: The result could not be recorded; a revert was attempted.
keys.change.participant_unavailable: Part of the desktop was not answering, so nothing was applied.
keys.change.prepare_failed: Preparing the new component failed, so nothing was applied.
keys.change.readback_mismatch: After applying, the actual state differed from the expected one; it was reverted.
keys.change.storage_error: The storage refused the write; nothing was changed.
keys.change.storage_full: The storage is full; nothing was changed.
keys.change.timed_revert_failed: The timed revert did not complete.
keys.conflict.base_revision_stale: The desktop changed while you were working; review it and try again.
keys.conflict.candidate_cannot_claim: The new component cannot take over this function.
keys.conflict.change_in_progress: Another change is in progress; wait for it to finish.
keys.conflict.profile_in_use: The composition in use cannot be deleted; switch to another one first.
keys.conflict.readback_mismatch: The actual state differs from the expected one.
keys.conflict.single_provider_taken: Another component already provides this function.
keys.diagnostics.shared_host_no_per_plugin_me: Shares its host with other plugins; its memory cannot be measured on its own.
keys.error.conflict: It conflicts with the current state and was not run.
keys.error.identity_rejected: The desktop service refused this connection; the session needs to be restarted.
keys.error.internal: The desktop service hit an internal error; see the diagnostics.
keys.error.invalid_params: The request was not valid and was not run.
keys.error.permission_denied: There is no permission for this; it was not run.
keys.error.preflight_rejected: The check did not pass; the settings are unchanged.
keys.error.protocol_version_unsupported: The desktop service's version is not compatible.
keys.error.timeout: It did not finish in time; the result is not confirmed yet.
keys.error.unsupported: This desktop does not support this action.
keys.generic.import: There is a problem with the import.
keys.generic.participant: Part of the desktop did not answer.
keys.generic.recovery: The change interrupted last time has been settled.
keys.import.digest_mismatch: The content does not match its checksum; it may have been modified.
keys.import.format_unsupported: This file format or version is not supported.
keys.import.grant_required: File permissions have to be granted separately; importing does not grant them.
keys.import.integrity_mismatch: A required package does not match what is installed.
keys.import.private_path_detected: The content includes a private file path and was refused.
keys.import.protocol_incompatible: This composition needs an incompatible version.
keys.import.schema_invalid: The content is not in the right format.
keys.import.secret_detected: The content appears to contain a secret and was refused.
keys.install.integrity_mismatch: The package does not match the expected checksum.
keys.install.invalid_package: This is not a valid package.
keys.install.storage_full: The storage is full; nothing was installed.
keys.participant.disconnected: The connection dropped mid-way; the result is decided by reading back.
keys.participant.timeout: This part did not answer in time.
keys.participant.unavailable: This part is not running right now.
keys.permission_denied.approval_unavailable: This needs approval, and there is no way to approve it right now, so it was not run.
keys.permission_denied.not_granted: This permission has not been granted.
keys.preflight.base_revision_stale: The desktop changed while you were working; review it and try again.
keys.preflight.budget_exceeded: “{package}” asks for more resources than allowed.
keys.preflight.command_conflict: Two components want to own the same command.
keys.preflight.declared_conflict: “{package}” declares it cannot be used together with another plugin.
keys.preflight.dependency_cycle: The plugins depend on each other in a cycle.
keys.preflight.integrity_mismatch: The content of “{package}” does not match its record.
keys.preflight.permission_required: The permission “{package}” asks for cannot be given.
keys.preflight.precondition_failed: The current state does not allow this change (for example the screen is locked, storage is low, or the source is not trusted).
keys.preflight.protocol_incompatible: “{package}” needs a version incompatible with this Ditto.
keys.preflight.shortcut_conflict: The shortcut “{chord}” is already in use or reserved by the system.
keys.preflight.single_provider_violation: A place can hold one component only, or this component cannot go there.
keys.preflight.stale_intent: The settings you saw are no longer current; review them again.
keys.preflight.version_conflict: “{package}” needs a version that is incompatible with what is installed.
keys.reason.dependency_not_ready: a service it needs was not ready
keys.reason.host_not_running: plugin services were not running; nothing had to be stopped
keys.reason.rescue_mode: applied once back in normal mode
keys.recovery.decided: The change interrupted last time was settled from the actual state.
keys.recovery.head_moved: The composition changed after the interruption; this change cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.interrupted: It was interrupted while being applied last time.
keys.recovery.no_base: The version before the change was not found; it cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.no_target: The version after the change was not found; it cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.participant_remembers: Settled from what each part of the desktop remembers.
keys.recovery.participant_unavailable: Part of the desktop did not answer; whether it took effect cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.read_failed: The actual state could not be read; whether it took effect cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.state_failed: The state could not be obtained; whether it took effect cannot be confirmed.
keys.recovery.transition_failed: The outcome could not be recorded.
keys.shortcut.command_failed: The shortcut's command did not run.
keys.trust.core_builtin: Built into Core; runs no code of its own.
keys.trust.same_host_no_isolation.cordis: Runs in the same host as the other service plugins, with no isolation between them.
keys.trust.same_host_no_isolation.qml: Runs in the desktop-interface process, with no isolation from the other desktop components.
keys.unavailable.compositor_offline: The window manager is not answering right now
keys.unavailable.host_crash_loop: Plugin services kept failing and are paused
keys.unavailable.lease_expired: The plugin providing this is not answering
keys.unavailable.participant_unavailable: Part of the desktop is not running
keys.unavailable.recovering: The change interrupted last time is being settled
keys.unavailable.rescue_mode: Rescue mode runs no plugin services
keys.unavailable.storage_error: The storage refused the write; nothing was changed
keys.unavailable.storage_full: The storage is full; nothing was changed
keys.unavailable.system_unavailable: A system service is not answering
